# citation.is — Registry

> The open registry of verified scientific claims. 3,900+ claims cross-referenced against UniProt, PubChem, NCBI Taxonomy, and PubMed. CC BY 4.0.

## What is in the registry?

Each entry in the registry is a structured scientific claim with:
- **Claim text** — the assertion as extracted from the source document
- **Verdict** — Supported, Refuted, Inconclusive, or Needs Context
- **Confidence score** — 0 to 1, reflecting strength of evidence
- **Source** — title, URL, and DOI of the originating publication
- **Entities** — resolved against UniProt (proteins), PubChem (compounds), NCBI Taxonomy (organisms), PubMed (publications)
- **Vertical** — research domain (structural biology, salmon biotech, etc.)

## Access the registry

- [JSON download](https://citation.is/api/public/claims.json) — All claims as structured JSON
- [OAI-PMH](https://citation.is/oai?verb=ListRecords&metadataPrefix=oai_dc) — Dublin Core feed for harvesters
- [Full corpus](https://citation.is/llms-full.txt) — All claims as markdown (for LLM ingestion)
- [RSS feed](https://citation.is/rss.xml) — Recently verified claims

## Statistics

- 3,900+ verified claims (as of June 2026)
- Cross-referenced against 4 authoritative databases
- Updated continuously as new documents are processed
